role: The static potion registry: the 32 slots with each potion's id, bad flag, liquid color, effectiveness and its attribute modifiers, plus the per tick performEffect and isReady logic.
scope_reason: Potion effects run in this game: food effects, the witch's splashes, the skeleton's wither and the spider's poison.

members.name: potionTypes
members.note: the static registry is three tables (bad flag, liquid color, effectiveness) plus the POT_* id enum (potion.h)

members.name: moveSpeed (the static potion instances, moveSlowdown through field_76408_G)
members.note: each instance's id, isBadEffect, liquidColor and effectiveness live in the POT_* tables; the attribute modifier map is the per id switch in potion_apply_attributes

members.name: Potion
members.note: the constructor's effects are baked into the static tables

members.name: setIconIndex
members.note: the inventory status icon, client GUI

members.name: getId
members.note: the id is the table index

members.name: performEffect
members.note: the regen, poison, wither and heal/harm branches run on living entities; the hunger and saturation player branches run in the server player's tick (survival.c:surv_server_potion_tick) and the client half in survival.c:client_potion_perform

members.name: affectEntity
members.note: the splash distance falloff and the undead heal/harm swap

members.name: isBadEffect
members.note: runs only when a frame is drawn (the row replays draw none): covframes' frame coverage runs it in cf-idx-tippotion-s1 (ItemPotion.addInformation's red lines)

members.name: isUsable
members.note: usable is false for every potion in the 1.7.10 registry, so getPotionEffects's filter is dead

members.name: func_111184_a
members.note: the per potion AttributeModifier objects and their UUIDs are folded into a per id switch

members.name: func_111186_k
members.note: the modifier map is internal to the switch

members.name: func_111183_a
members.note: the amplifier scaling runs per id in the switch

notes: The hunger and saturation branches touch the FoodStats, so they live on the server player's twin path (survival.c:surv_server_potion_tick) rather than the generic living body; the client half never moves the client's own health (EntityClientPlayerMP's empty heal, survival.c:3673). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers; names and icons are GUI text. Formerly listed as missing: the attribute modifier map (field_111188_I): the modifiers' UUID strings and the generic map walk are replaced by a per id switch in potion.c:potion_apply_attributes and potion_remove_attributes; the saved NBT's modifier UUID is written by the attribute path (csrc/engine/entity_nbt.c) the name, icon index and duration string: client GUI only, never reached by the native client getDurationString and the names and status icons the effect column draws are raster_hud.c's draw_effects and POTIONS.
